description: This PHP class defines the ClientEntity implementing OAuth2 client interface, encapsulating client data such as identifier, name, redirect URI, confidentiality status, and display name. It includes methods for constructing an instance and creating one from an OAuthClient entity.

classes.name: ClientEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth client entity, holding client-specific data including identifier, name, redirect URI, confidentiality status, and display name, and providing methods to access this data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ClientEntity with provided client data.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Creates a ClientEntity instance from an OAuthClient entity.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with the client.

methods.name: isConfidential
methods.description: Indicates whether the client is confidential.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name for the client.
